snippet.title: Lily's World - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Lily's World XD, an investigative psychological horror game developed by SonderingEmily. Players will explore a 2004 laptop to access messages, read diary entries, and compile clues to discern what became of Lily. Lily's World XD is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
